title: Stabilize canonical repo control files
notes: docs/spec/spec.md, docs/spec/checklist.json, docs/spec/update_history, and README.md aligned for first version. Spec delta: update_history format changed to Markdown (v0.1.6); spec-to-checklist relationship section added. Re-verify that update_history tooling and README references reflect Markdown format.

title: Implement discovery and deterministic parsing
notes: Scan host-aware Codex or Claude skill roots, detect ecosystems, parse SKILL.md plus companion files, and include hard security/privacy checks. Spec delta (v0.1.5): HOST_ECOSYSTEM_UNKNOWN must exit non-zero with a message directing the user to pass --ecosystem explicitly.

title: Implement secret, privacy, and suspicious execution detection
notes: Hard-fail embedded secrets, private data, curl-or-wget pipe-to-shell patterns, and direct opaque binary execution from hooks or shell snippets.

title: Implement runtime state writes and report generation
notes: Write audit run snapshots, ledgers, global index, and text/json/markdown reports without introducing any standalone external API dependency. Spec delta (v0.1.5): ledger note field is operator-owned and must never be overwritten by automated audit; change_log is append-only; ledger files are only deleted by explicit user-initiated prune, never by automated audit.

title: Implement watch mode and git hook gate
notes: Debounced watch-based auditing and deterministic git-hook blocking. Spec delta (v0.1.5): watch entry point is skill-auditor watch [path...]; process must handle SIGINT/SIGTERM for clean shutdown; concurrent watch processes against overlapping roots are allowed and must not require cross-process locking.

title: Implement clustering, heuristic analysis, and active-set recommendation
notes: Keep deterministic and heuristic findings separate, prefer host-native enhancements, and cap recommendations at configured max. Spec delta (v0.1.5): cap is configurable via --active-set-max flag (default 30); implementation must read this from CLI args and not hardcode the value.

title: Keep the auditor directly usable in Codex and Claude Code without external API setup
notes: Do not add standalone api_key, endpoint, or audit-service requirements; optional semantic logic must use host-native surfaces or degrade to skipped.
